summary:
This is Dr. Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor.
He was born on 27 July 1972, in Kuala Lumpur.
He is an Orthopaedic Surgeon, a doctor for bones.
In 2007, he joined the Angkasawan Program and became the First Malaysian in Space!
He launched on 10 October 2007, in Soyuz TMA-11.
He returned on 21 October 2007.
He spent 10 days and 21 hours in space, and 9 days on the ISS.
details:
This is Dr. Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor.

He was born on 27 July 1972, in Kuala Lumpur.

He is an Orthopaedic Surgeon, a doctor for bones.

In 2007, he joined the Angkasawan Program and became the First Malaysian in Space!

He launched on 10 October 2007, in Soyuz TMA-11.

He returned on 21 October 2007.

He spent 10 days and 21 hours in space, and 9 days on the ISS.
